integrity_notes: Infinite validity rests on a proved r<=167 bound and exact enumeration of all 399 admissible prime triples; the appended checker and its actual output are self-contained. Scientific originality is checked against inspected literature and accessible prior claims, not independently certified.
limitations: All squarefree integers with four distinct prime factors are classified; the odd case is ruled out by an abundance inequality. Nonsquarefree and other prime-factor-count classes are outside scope.
title: The squarefree four-prime 2-near-perfect numbers
